runtimeIntegration.notes: Documentation and mapping groundwork only. The current web/iPad runtime continues to load src/mappings.json.

device.ownership: Mirror-only hardware node. Not a transport owner, not a continuous shaping surface, and not a deep-edit controller.

sourceOfTruth.placeholderPolicy: Null OSC/MIDI values are unresolved transport details and must be confirmed against the live-rig mapping before activation.

transportModel.summary: OSC-first for semantic scene/state actions. Hybrid MIDI+OSC for audiovisual event strikes and texture toggle.
constraints: Do not treat Maschine MK1 as a master transport surface.
Do not collapse semantic scene/state commands into MIDI-only behavior.
Do not move continuous shaping away from Edirol or analysis bias away from frZone.
